schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to financially weak students of the University of Delhi to help them overcome financial challenges and continue their education without hardship.

children.text: The Department of Distance & Education, School of Open Learning, Campus of Open Learning (DDCE/SOL/COL), in the spirit of facilitating financially weak students as per guidelines decided by the University of Delhi, has announced the Financial Support Scheme for DDCE/SOL/COL students. This scheme is reflected through a fee waiver/refund for the students enrolled in DDCE/SOL/COL and having their family income below the poverty line. The fee waiver/refund includes all components of the fee paid by students except the examination fee and the university fee.
